title: The Crew: Mission Deep Sea
subtitle: A cooperative trick-taking expedition into the oceanic abyss with limited communication
tagline: In the crushing depths of the deep sea, silent cooperation is your only lifeline
loreSummary: Mysterious acoustic anomalies echo from the ocean floor, hinting at the lost civilization of Mu. As an elite submersible expedition crew, you must coordinate complex underwater maneuvers across 32 escalating missions to uncover secrets hidden thousands of meters beneath the waves.
keyFeatures: Dynamic task card system with variable difficulty values tailored to player counts
32 sequential narrative missions exploring the abyssal zones of the ocean
Strictly limited acoustic communication simulating deep-sea signal attenuation
Emergency sonar beacon mechanic and customizable challenge parameters

fast_dive_arc.name: Twilight Trench Descent
fast_dive_arc.description: Missions 1 to 15, descending through the epipelagic and twilight zones to investigate initial sonar anomalies.

deep_sea_logbook_standard.name: Standard Logbook Campaign
deep_sea_logbook_standard.description: The complete 32-mission deep sea narrative logbook from surface departure to the discovery of the sunken ruins of Mu.

deep_sea_abyssal_mastery.name: Abyssal Ocean Mastery
deep_sea_abyssal_mastery.description: All 32 logbook missions plus high-difficulty bonus dives using max difficulty task card combinations and zero sonar distress signals.

milestones.title: Submersible Dive Certification
milestones.phase: Phase I — Coastal Departure & Pressure Calibration
milestones.description: Calibrate life-support systems, test underwater communication limitations, and clear surface training drills.

milestones.title: The Twilight Zone & Bioluminescent Abyss
milestones.description: Plunge past the reach of sunlight into perpetual dusk, navigating shifting oceanic currents and bio-optical interference.

milestones.title: Hydrothermal Vents & Thermal Updrafts
milestones.description: Maneuver through scorching volcanic chimneys and acoustic dead zones while structural alarms sound under crushing pressure.

milestones.title: The Mariana Trench & Sunken Anomalies
milestones.description: Descend into the deepest oceanic trench on Earth, tracing anomalous acoustic signals echoing from ancient underwater trenches.

milestones.title: The Lost Continent of Mu
milestones.description: Uncover the submerged ruins of legendary Mu in the abyssal rift and execute flawless cooperative maneuvers to surface safely.
